business_summary: SK hynix Inc. is a KOSPI-listed memory manufacturer and the incumbent leader in high-bandwidth memory for AI accelerators. Unlike Samsung it is close to a pure memory business, so its consolidated financials are a far more direct expression of this chain's HBM link than a conglomerate's would be.

exposure_summary.narrative: Two ACTIVE placements, both VERIFIED from SK hynix's own newsroom: hbm-memory (position 8, heat CROWDED at crowdedness 78) on HBM4 mass shipment from the second quarter of 2026, and advanced-packaging (position 7, heat EMERGING) on the TSV and Advanced MR-MUF stacking that HBM production depends on. The second placement is genuinely a different link rather than a restatement of the first: the packaging technique is the thing that has gated HBM yield.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: SK hynix reports by product family rather than by AI end market, and no percentage of revenue attributable to HBM specifically was read from a primary SK hynix source this run.

latest_fy.basis: Fiscal-year revenue for the period ended 2025-12-31: 97,146,675,000,000 KRW from the yfinance-statements statements in 000660-KS.json.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Compound annual revenue growth computed as (97,146,675,000,000/44,621,568,000,000)**(1/3.0007)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 47,206,319,000,000 KRW divided by revenue 97,146,675,000,000 KRW, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 53,373,126,000,000 KRW divided by net income 42,919,287,000,000 KRW, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 53,373,126,000,000 KRW less capex 28,579,343,000,000 KRW, divided by revenue 97,146,675,000,000 KRW, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 9,834,082,000,000 KRW (total debt 24,757,848,000,000 less cash 14,923,766,000,000, as of 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 61,136,449,000,000 KRW (operating income 47,206,319,000,000 plus depreciation 13,930,130,000,000 for the period ended 2025-12-31), from the yfinance-statements series.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 8 (state STRONG) computed over yfinance-statements statements in 000660-KS.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found.

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.289 against the -1.78 threshold, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over yfinance-statements statements in 000660-KS.json quality.beneish, 12 of 12 inputs found.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 1,159,896,082,560,000 KRW computed in 000660-KS.json quality.derived.market_cap from vendor/official share count and price (method section 6A vendor-aggregate fundamentals).

price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 1,159,896,082,560,000 KRW divided by revenue 97,146,675,000,000 KRW for the period ended 2025-12-31.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 1,169,730,164,560,000 KRW implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 24,793,783,000,000 KRW, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over yfinance-statements statements. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': 0.3022, '7': 0.225, '10': 0.1703}). Measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a price statement.

crowdedness_caveats: hbm-memory carries the highest crowdedness score of the four links this batch touches: 78, verdict CROWDED (data/chains/ai-infrastructure.json). SK hynix is the most-identified name on that link.
data/market/000660-KS.json carries a single-source price print rather than an agreed dual-source one, and no pcs block, so neither price confidence nor crowdedness was measured for this listing.
The purity that makes SK hynix a clean expression of the HBM link also removes any offsetting segment if HBM pricing turns.
No valuation multiple is computed anywhere on this profile, so this file contains no basis for a priced-in judgement.

risks.claim: No admissible financial fact exists for this issuer, so an HBM leadership position that is well established in the trade press cannot be tested here against revenue, margin, leverage, earnings quality or valuation.

risks.claim: Both placements express the same underlying HBM franchise through two links. A selection stage weighing this issuer would have to treat that as one economic exposure counted twice, not as diversification.
Against that: no pcs (positioning/attention) block exists to corroborate or refute the chain's own crowdedness read.
